en: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us. He said: I read to Malik, from Ibn Shihab, from al-Araj, from Abu Hurayra, that he used to say: What a bad food is the food of a wedding feast: the rich are invited to it and the poor are left out. Whoever does not attend the invitation has disobeyed Allah and His Messenger.
de: Yahya ibn Yahya überlieferte uns. Er sagte: I read to Malik, from Ibn Shihab, from al-Araj, from Abu Hurayra, that he used to say: What a bad food is the food of a Hochzeitsmahl: the rich are invited to it and the poor are left out. Whoever does not attend the invitation has disobeyed Allah and His Messenger. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Ibn Abi Umar narrated to us. Sufyan narrated to us. He said: I asked al-Zuhri: Abu Bakr, how is this hadith, “The worst food is the food of the rich”? He laughed and said: It is not “the worst food is the food of the rich.” Sufyan said: My father was wealthy, and this hadith frightened me when I heard it, so I asked al-Zuhri about it. He said: Abd al-Rahman al-Araj narrated to me that he heard Abu Hurayra say: The worst food is the food of a wedding feast. Then he mentioned something like Malik's hadith.
de: Ibn Abi Umar überlieferte uns. Sufyan überlieferte uns. Er sagte: I asked al-Zuhri: Abu Bakr, how is this hadith, “The worst food is the food of the rich”? He laughed and said: It is not “the worst food is the food of the rich.” Sufyan said: My father was wealthy, and this hadith frightened me when I heard it, so I asked al-Zuhri about it. Er sagte: Abd al-Rahman al-Araj überlieferte mir that he heard Abu Hurayra say: The worst food is the food of a Hochzeitsmahl. Then he mentioned something like Malik's hadith. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Muhammad ibn Rafi and Abd ibn Humayd narrated to me, from Abd al-Razzaq. Ma'mar informed us, from al-Zuhri, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib and from al-Araj, from Abu Hurayra. He said: The worst food is the food of a wedding feast, like Malik's hadith. Ibn Abi Umar narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Abu al-Zinad, from al-Araj, from Abu Hurayra, with similar wording.
de: Muhammad ibn Rafi and Abd ibn Humayd überlieferte mir, from Abd al-Razzaq. Ma'mar berichtete uns, from al-Zuhri, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib and from al-Araj, from Abu Hurayra. Er sagte: The worst food is the food of a Hochzeitsmahl, like Malik's hadith. Ibn Abi Umar überlieferte uns, from Sufyan, from Abu al-Zinad, from al-Araj, from Abu Hurayra, with similar wording. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Ibn Abi Umar narrated to us. Sufyan narrated to us. He said: I heard Ziyad ibn Sad say: I heard Thabit al-Araj narrate from Abu Hurayra that the Prophet (peace be upon him) said: The worst food is the food of a wedding feast. It is withheld from whoever comes to it, while those who reject it are invited. Whoever does not accept the invitation has disobeyed Allah and His Messenger.
de: Ibn Abi Umar überlieferte uns. Sufyan überlieferte uns. Er sagte: I heard Ziyad ibn Sad say: I heard Thabit al-Araj narrate from Abu Hurayra that der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm) said: The worst food is the food of a Hochzeitsmahl. It is withheld from whoever comes to it, while those who reject it are invited. Whoever does not accept the invitation has disobeyed Allah and His Messenger. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Amr al-Naqid narrated to us, and the wording is Amr's. They both said: Sufyan narrated to us, from al-Zuhri, from Urwah, from Aisha. She said: The wife of Rifaah came to the Prophet (peace be upon him) and said: I was with Rifaah, and he divorced me with an irrevocable divorce. Then I married Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Zubayr, but what he has is like the fringe of a garment. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) smiled and said: Do you want to return to Rifaah? No, not until you taste his intimacy and he tastes your intimacy. She said: Abu Bakr was with him, and Khalid was at the door waiting for permission. He called: Abu Bakr, do you not hear what this woman says openly in the presence of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him)?
de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Amr al-Naqid überlieferte uns, and the wording is Amr's. They both said: Sufyan überlieferte uns, from al-Zuhri, from Urwah, from Aisha. She said: The wife of Rifaah came to der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm) and said: I was with Rifaah, and he geschieden me with an irrevocable Scheidung. Then I married Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Zubayr, but what he has is like the fringe of a garment. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) smiled and said: Do you want to return to Rifaah? No, not until you taste his Intimität and he tastes your Intimität. She said: Abu Bakr was with him, and Khalid was at the door waiting for permission. He called: Abu Bakr, do you not hear what this woman says openly in the presence of der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm)? Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu al-Tahir and Harmalah ibn Yahya narrated to me, and the wording is Harmalah's. Abu al-Tahir said: He narrated to us, and Harmalah said: Ibn Wahb informed us. Yunus informed me, from Ibn Shihab. Urwah ibn al-Zubayr narrated to me that Aisha, the wife of the Prophet (peace be upon him), told him: Rifaah al-Qurazi divorced his wife with an irrevocable divorce. She then married Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Zubayr and came to the Prophet (peace be upon him), saying: Messenger of Allah, I was with Rifaah and he divorced me with the final of three divorces. Then I married Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Zubayr, and by Allah he has only something like a fringe. She took a fringe of her garment. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) smiled and laughed, then said: Perhaps you want to return to Rifaah? No, until he tastes your intimacy and you taste his intimacy. Abu Bakr al-Siddiq was sitting with the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him), and Khalid ibn Sa'id ibn al-As was sitting at the door of the room without permission. Khalid began calling Abu Bakr: Will you not stop this woman from saying openly what she says in the presence of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him)?
de: Abu al-Tahir and Harmalah ibn Yahya überlieferte mir, and the wording is Harmalah's. Abu al-Tahir said: He überlieferte uns, and Harmalah said: Ibn Wahb berichtete uns. Yunus berichtete mir, from Ibn Shihab. Urwah ibn al-Zubayr überlieferte mir that Aisha, the wife of der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), told him: Rifaah al-Qurazi geschieden his wife with an irrevocable Scheidung. She then married Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Zubayr and came to der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), saying: Messenger of Allah, I was with Rifaah and he geschieden me with the final of three Scheidungs. Then I married Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Zubayr, and by Allah he has only something like a fringe. She took a fringe of her garment. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) smiled and laughed, then said: Perhaps you want to return to Rifaah? No, until he tastes your Intimität and you taste his Intimität. Abu Bakr al-Siddiq was sitting with der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm), and Khalid ibn Sa'id ibn al-As was sitting at the door of the room without permission. Khalid began calling Abu Bakr: Will you not stop this woman from saying openly what she says in the presence of der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm)? Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Abd ibn Humayd informed us. Abd al-Razzaq informed us. Ma'mar informed us, from al-Zuhri, from Urwah, from Aisha. Rifaah al-Qurazi divorced his wife, and Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Zubayr married her. She came to the Prophet (peace be upon him) and said: Messenger of Allah, Rifaah divorced her with the final of three divorces. It is like the hadith of Yunus.
de: Abd ibn Humayd berichtete uns. Abd al-Razzaq berichtete uns. Ma'mar berichtete uns, from al-Zuhri, from Urwah, from Aisha. Rifaah al-Qurazi geschieden his wife, and Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Zubayr married her. She came to der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm) and said: Messenger of Allah, Rifaah geschieden her with the final of three Scheidungs. It is like the hadith of Yunus. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Muhammad ibn al-Ala al-Hamdani narrated to us. Abu Usamah narrated to us, from Hisham, from his father, from Aisha. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) was asked about a woman whom a man marries and then divorces, after which she marries another man who divorces her before consummating the marriage: is she lawful for her first husband? He said: No, not until he tastes her intimacy.
de: Muhammad ibn al-Ala al-Hamdani überlieferte uns. Abu Usamah überlieferte uns, from Hisham, from his father, from Aisha. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) was asked about a woman whom a man marries and then Scheidungs, after which she marries another man who Scheidungs her before consummating the Ehe: is she lawful for her first husband? Er sagte: No, not until he tastes her Intimität. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us. Ibn Fudayl narrated to us. Abu Kurayb narrated to us. Abu Muawiyah narrated to us. All of them narrated from Hisham with this chain.
de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah überlieferte uns. Ibn Fudayl überlieferte uns. Abu Kurayb überlieferte uns. Abu Muawiyah überlieferte uns. All of them narrated from Hisham with this chain. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us. Ali ibn Mushir narrated to us, from Ubayd Allah ibn Umar, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Aisha. She said: A man divorced his wife three times. Another man married her and then divorced her before consummating the marriage. Her first husband wanted to marry her, so the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) was asked about it. He said: No, not until the latter tastes of her intimacy what the first tasted.
de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah überlieferte uns. Ali ibn Mushir überlieferte uns, from Ubayd Allah ibn Umar, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Aisha. She said: A man geschieden his wife three times. Another man married her and then geschieden her before consummating the Ehe. Her first husband wanted to marry her, so der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) was asked about it. Er sagte: No, not until the latter tastes of her Intimität what the first tasted. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Muhammad ibn Abd Allah ibn Numayr narrated it to us. My father narrated to us. Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated it to us. Yahya, meaning Ibn Sa'id, narrated to us. All of them narrated from Ubayd Allah with this meaning. In Yahya's narration from Ubayd Allah: al-Qasim narrated to us, from Aisha.
de: Muhammad ibn Abd Allah ibn Numayr narrated it to us. My father überlieferte uns. Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated it to us. Yahya, meaning Ibn Sa'id, überlieferte uns. All of them narrated from Ubayd Allah with this meaning. In Yahya's narration from Ubayd Allah: al-Qasim überlieferte uns, from Aisha. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Yahya ibn Yahya and Ishaq ibn Ibrahim narrated to us, and the wording is Yahya's. They both said: Jarir informed us, from Mansur, from Salim, from Kurayb, from Ibn Abbas. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: If one of you, when he intends to have intercourse with his wife, says, “In the name of Allah. O Allah, keep Satan away from us and keep Satan away from what You grant us,” and a child is decreed between them through that, Satan will never harm it.
de: Yahya ibn Yahya and Ishaq ibn Ibrahim überlieferte uns, and the wording is Yahya's. They both said: Jarir berichtete uns, from Mansur, from Salim, from Kurayb, from Ibn Abbas. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: If one of you, when he intends to have Geschlechtsverkehr with his wife, says, “In the name of Allah. O Allah, keep Satan away from us and keep Satan away from what You grant us,” and a child is decreed between them through that, Satan will never harm it. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna and Ibn Bashshar narrated to us. Muhammad ibn Jafar narrated to us. Ibn Numayr narrated to us. My father narrated to us. Abd ibn Humayd informed us. Abd al-Razzaq informed us. All of them narrated from al-Thawri, both from Mansur, with the meaning of Jarir's hadith. Shubah's narration does not mention “In the name of Allah.” Abd al-Razzaq's narration from al-Thawri does mention “In the name of Allah.” Ibn Numayr's narration says: Mansur, I think, said “In the name of Allah.”
de: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna and Ibn Bashshar überlieferte uns. Muhammad ibn Jafar überlieferte uns. Ibn Numayr überlieferte uns. My father überlieferte uns. Abd ibn Humayd berichtete uns. Abd al-Razzaq berichtete uns. All of them narrated from al-Thawri, both from Mansur, with the meaning of Jarir's hadith. Shubah's narration does not mention “In the name of Allah.” Abd al-Razzaq's narration from al-Thawri does mention “In the name of Allah.” Ibn Numayr's narration says: Mansur, I think, said “In the name of Allah.” Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id, Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, and Amr al-Naqid narrated to us, and the wording is Abu Bakr's. They said: Sufyan narrated to us, from Ibn al-Munkadir, who heard Jabir say: The Jews used to say that if a man had intercourse with his wife from behind in her vagina, the child would be cross-eyed. Then this was revealed: “Your wives are a tilth for you, so go to your tilth however you wish” (Quran 2:223).
de: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id, Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, and Amr al-Naqid überlieferte uns, and the wording is Abu Bakr's. They said: Sufyan überlieferte uns, from Ibn al-Munkadir, who heard Jabir say: The Jews used to say that if a man had Geschlechtsverkehr with his wife from behind in her vagina, the child would be cross-eyed. Then this was revealed: “Your wives are a tilth for you, so go to your tilth however you wish” (Quran 2:223). Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Muhammad ibn Rumh narrated to us. al-Layth informed us, from Ibn al-Had, from Abu Hazim, from Muhammad ibn al-Munkadir, from Jabir ibn Abd Allah. The Jews used to say that if a woman was approached from behind in her vagina and became pregnant, her child would be cross-eyed. He said: Then this was revealed: “Your wives are a tilth for you, so go to your tilth however you wish” (Quran 2:223).
de: Muhammad ibn Rumh überlieferte uns. al-Layth berichtete uns, from Ibn al-Had, from Abu Hazim, from Muhammad ibn al-Munkadir, from Jabir ibn Abd Allah. The Jews used to say that if a woman was approached from behind in her vagina and became pregnant, her child would be cross-eyed. Er sagte: Then this was revealed: “Your wives are a tilth for you, so go to your tilth however you wish” (Quran 2:223). Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated it to us. Abu Awanah narrated to us. Abd al-Warith ibn Abd al-Samad narrated to us, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ayyub. Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us. Wahb ibn Jarir narrated to us. Shubah narrated to us. Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us. Abd al-Rahman narrated to us. Sufyan narrated to us. Ubayd Allah ibn Sa'id, Harun ibn Abd Allah, and Abu Main al-Raqashi narrated to me. They said: Wahb ibn Jarir narrated to us. My father narrated to us: I heard al-Numan ibn Rashid narrate from al-Zuhri. Sulayman ibn Mabid narrated to me. Muala ibn Asad narrated to us. Abd al-Aziz, Ibn al-Mukhtar, narrated to us, from Suhayl ibn Abi Salih. All of them narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Munkadir, from Jabir, with this hadith. In al-Numan's narration from al-Zuhri: whether she wishes, with him bent forward, or whether she wishes, in another manner, but all in one opening.
de: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated it to us. Abu Awanah überlieferte uns. Abd al-Warith ibn Abd al-Samad überlieferte uns, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ayyub. Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna überlieferte uns. Wahb ibn Jarir überlieferte uns. Shubah überlieferte uns. Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna überlieferte uns. Abd al-Rahman überlieferte uns. Sufyan überlieferte uns. Ubayd Allah ibn Sa'id, Harun ibn Abd Allah, and Abu Main al-Raqashi überlieferte mir. They said: Wahb ibn Jarir überlieferte uns. My father überlieferte uns: I heard al-Numan ibn Rashid narrate from al-Zuhri. Sulayman ibn Mabid überlieferte mir. Muala ibn Asad überlieferte uns. Abd al-Aziz, Ibn al-Mukhtar, überlieferte uns, from Suhayl ibn Abi Salih. All of them narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Munkadir, from Jabir, with this hadith. In al-Numan's narration from al-Zuhri: whether she wishes, with him bent forward, or whether she wishes, in another manner, but all in one opening. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna and Ibn Bashshar narrated to us, and the wording is Ibn al-Muthanna's. Muhammad ibn Jafar narrated to us. Shubah narrated to us. He said: I heard Qatadah narrate from Zurarah ibn Awfa, from Abu Hurayra, from the Prophet (peace be upon him), who said: When a woman spends the night abandoning her husband's bed, the angels curse her until morning.
de: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna and Ibn Bashshar überlieferte uns, and the wording is Ibn al-Muthanna's. Muhammad ibn Jafar überlieferte uns. Shubah überlieferte uns. Er sagte: I heard Qatadah narrate from Zurarah ibn Awfa, from Abu Hurayra, from der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), who said: When a woman spends the night abandoning her husband's bed, the Engel curse her until morning. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Yahya ibn Habib narrated it to me. Khalid, meaning Ibn al-Harith, narrated to us. Shubah narrated to us with this chain and said: until she returns.
de: Yahya ibn Habib narrated it to me. Khalid, meaning Ibn al-Harith, überlieferte uns. Shubah überlieferte uns with this chain and said: until she returns. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Ibn Abi Umar narrated to us. Marwan narrated to us, from Yazid, meaning Ibn Kaysan, from Abu Hazim, from Abu Hurayra. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: By Him in whose hand is my soul, whenever a man calls his wife to his bed and she refuses him, the One who is in heaven remains angry with her until he is pleased with her.
de: Ibn Abi Umar überlieferte uns. Marwan überlieferte uns, from Yazid, meaning Ibn Kaysan, from Abu Hazim, from Abu Hurayra. Er sagte: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: By Him in whose hand is my soul, whenever a man calls his wife to his bed and she refuses him, the One who is in heaven remains angry with her until he is pleased with her. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Abu Kurayb narrated to us. Abu Muawiyah narrated to us. Abu Sa'id al-Ashajj narrated to me. Waki narrated to us. Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to me, and his is the wording. Jarir narrated to us. All of them narrated from al-Amash, from Abu Hazim, from Abu Hurayra. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: When a man calls his wife to his bed and she does not come to him, and he spends the night angry with her, the angels curse her until morning.
de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Abu Kurayb überlieferte uns. Abu Muawiyah überlieferte uns. Abu Sa'id al-Ashajj überlieferte mir. Waki überlieferte uns. Zuhayr ibn Harb überlieferte mir, and his is the wording. Jarir überlieferte uns. All of them narrated from al-Amash, from Abu Hazim, from Abu Hurayra. Er sagte: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: When a man calls his wife to his bed and she does not come to him, and he spends the night angry with her, the Engel curse her until morning. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us. Marwan ibn Muawiyah narrated to us, from Umar ibn Hamzah al-Umari. Abd al-Rahman ibn Sad narrated to us. He said: I heard Abu Sa'id al-Khudri say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Among the people in the lowest position before Allah on the Day of Resurrection is a man who has intercourse with his wife and she with him, then he spreads her secret.
de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah überlieferte uns. Marwan ibn Muawiyah überlieferte uns, from Umar ibn Hamzah al-Umari. Abd al-Rahman ibn Sad überlieferte uns. Er sagte: I heard Abu Sa'id al-Khudri say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Among the people in the lowest position before Allah on the Day of Resurrection is a man who has Geschlechtsverkehr with his wife and she with him, then he spreads her Geheimnis. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Muhammad ibn Abd Allah ibn Numayr and Abu Kurayb narrated to us. Abu Usamah narrated to us, from Umar ibn Hamzah, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Sad. He said: I heard Abu Sa'id al-Khudri say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Among the greatest trusts before Allah on the Day of Resurrection is a man who has intercourse with his wife and she with him, then he spreads her secret. Ibn Numayr said: “The greatest.”
de: Muhammad ibn Abd Allah ibn Numayr and Abu Kurayb überlieferte uns. Abu Usamah überlieferte uns, from Umar ibn Hamzah, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Sad. Er sagte: I heard Abu Sa'id al-Khudri say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Among the greatest trusts before Allah on the Day of Resurrection is a man who has Geschlechtsverkehr with his wife and she with him, then he spreads her Geheimnis. Ibn Numayr said: “The greatest.” Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Yahya ibn Ayyub, Qutaybah ibn Sa'id, and Ali ibn Hujr narrated to us. They said: Ismail ibn Jafar narrated to us. Rabi'ah informed me, from Muhammad ibn Yahya ibn Habban, from Ibn Muhayriz. He said: Abu Sirmah and I entered upon Abu Sa'id al-Khudri. Abu Sirmah asked him: Abu Sa'id, did you hear the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) mention withdrawal? He said: Yes. We went with the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) on the expedition to Banu al-Mustaliq, captured noble Arab women, and our separation from our wives became long. We desired ransom and wanted to have intercourse and withdraw. We said: We will do it while the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) is among us, without asking him. Then we asked the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him), and he said: You are not at fault if you do not do it. No soul that Allah has decreed to be created until the Day of Resurrection will fail to be created.
de: Yahya ibn Ayyub, Qutaybah ibn Sa'id, and Ali ibn Hujr überlieferte uns. They said: Ismail ibn Jafar überlieferte uns. Rabi'ah berichtete mir, from Muhammad ibn Yahya ibn Habban, from Ibn Muhayriz. Er sagte: Abu Sirmah and I entered upon Abu Sa'id al-Khudri. Abu Sirmah asked him: Abu Sa'id, did you hear der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) mention Coitus interruptus? Er sagte: Yes. We went with der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) on the expedition to Banu al-Mustaliq, captured noble Arab women, and our separation from our wives became long. We desired ransom and wanted to have Geschlechtsverkehr and withdraw. We said: We will do it while der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) is among us, without asking him. Then we asked der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm), and he said: You are not at fault if you do not do it. No soul that Allah has decreed to be created until the Day of Resurrection will fail to be created. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Muhammad ibn al-Faraj, the freedman of Banu Hashim, narrated to me. Muhammad ibn al-Zibriqan narrated to us. Musa ibn Uqbah narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn Yahya ibn Habban, with the meaning of Rabiah's hadith, except that he said: Allah has decreed whoever He is to create until the Day of Resurrection.
de: Muhammad ibn al-Faraj, the freedman of Banu Hashim, überlieferte mir. Muhammad ibn al-Zibriqan überlieferte uns. Musa ibn Uqbah überlieferte uns, from Muhammad ibn Yahya ibn Habban, with the meaning of Rabiah's hadith, except that he said: Allah has decreed whoever He is to create until the Day of Resurrection. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Abd Allah ibn Muhammad ibn Asma al-Dubai narrated to me. Juwayriyah narrated to us, from Malik, from al-Zuhri, from Ibn Muhayriz, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri. He informed him: We captured female prisoners and practiced withdrawal. Then we asked the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) about it, and he said to us: Do you really do it? Do you really do it? Do you really do it? No soul that is to exist until the Day of Resurrection will exist except that it will exist.
de: Abd Allah ibn Muhammad ibn Asma al-Dubai überlieferte mir. Juwayriyah überlieferte uns, from Malik, from al-Zuhri, from Ibn Muhayriz, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri. He informed him: We captured female prisoners and practiced Coitus interruptus. Then we asked der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) about it, and he said to us: Do you really do it? Do you really do it? Do you really do it? No soul that is to exist until the Day of Resurrection will exist except that it will exist. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Nasr ibn Ali al-Jahdami narrated to us. Bishr ibn al-Mufaddal narrated to us. Shubah narrated to us, from Anas ibn Sirin, from Mabid ibn Sirin, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri. I said to him: Did you hear it from Abu Sa'id? He said: Yes, from the Prophet (peace be upon him), who said: You are not at fault if you do not do it; it is only destiny.

en: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna and Ibn Bashshar narrated to us. Muhammad ibn Jafar narrated to us. Yahya ibn Habib narrated to us. Khalid, meaning Ibn al-Harith, narrated to us. Muhammad ibn Hatim narrated to me. Abd al-Rahman ibn Mahdi and Bahz narrated to us. They all narrated from Shubah, from Anas ibn Sirin, with this chain and the same meaning. In their narration from the Prophet (peace be upon him), concerning withdrawal, he said: You are not at fault if you do not do that; it is only destiny. In Bahz's narration, Shubah said: I asked him whether he heard it from Abu Sa'id, and he said: Yes.

Muhammad ibn Hatim überlieferte mir. Abd al-Rahman ibn Mahdi and Bahz überlieferte uns. They all narrated from Shubah, from Anas ibn Sirin, with this chain and the same meaning. In their narration from der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), concerning Coitus interruptus, he said: You are not at fault if you do not do that; it is only Schicksal. en: Abu al-Rabi al-Zahrani and Abu Kamil al-Jahdari narrated to me, and the wording is Abu Kamil's. They both said: Hammad, Ibn Zayd, narrated to us. Ayyub narrated to us, from Muhammad, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Bishr ibn Masud, who traced it back to Abu Sa'id al-Khudri. The Prophet (peace be upon him) was asked about withdrawal and said: You are not at fault if you do not do that; it is only destiny. Muhammad said: The wording “you are not at fault” is closer to a prohibition.

en: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us. Muadh ibn Muadh narrated to us. Ibn Awn narrated to us, from Muhammad, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Bishr al-Ansari. He traced the hadith back to Abu Sa'id al-Khudri. Withdrawal was mentioned before the Prophet (peace be upon him), and he said: What is this? They said: A man has a wife who nurses, so he has intercourse with her but dislikes that she become pregnant by him; and a man has a slave woman, so he has intercourse with her but dislikes that she become pregnant by him. He said: You are not at fault if you do not do that; it is only destiny. Ibn Awn said: I told al-Hasan this, and he said: By Allah, it sounds like a rebuke.

en: Hajjaj ibn al-Shair narrated to me. Sulayman ibn Harb narrated to us. Hammad ibn Zayd narrated to us, from Ibn Awn. He said: I told Muhammad, from Ibrahim, the hadith of Abd al-Rahman ibn Bishr, meaning the hadith about withdrawal. He said: Abd al-Rahman ibn Bishr told it to me.
